context_rule: Canonical labels p in0..3; other three context IDs receive a random permutation of shifts1,2,3; label=(p+shift[c])%4. Hidden generating rule is not supplied to any learner. Every word has four distinct labels across balanced four contexts.

data.support: Teach one randomly selected alias per canonical meaning per new context; hold out its sibling. Same scalar operation labels and explicit context/word boundaries for all arms.

shared_base: E8 ->linear4->softmax, canonical8labels,800Adamupdates; common checkpoint forked to semantic_p4 and raw_e8 heads. Base stays frozen during context and correction phases.

joint_context: WordE8 +contextC8 concatenated ->tanh32 ->linear4; all parameters trainable. Fourcontext rows allocated fromstart, unobserved rows unchanged during canonical training. No autonomous architecturegrowth claim.

nuisance_diagnostic.definition: Independent per-alias Gaussian directions projected into null(W); atamplitude1 the perturbation RMS equals canonicalE RMS. Same checkpoint, labels, initialization andupdates as amplitude0. No strength tuning.
nuisance_diagnostic.checks: Record rank/nullity/RMS, maxchange in canonical logits and unchanged canonical predictions; P4 equality numerical tolerance only
nuisance_diagnostic.interpretation: Constructed stress of directions ignored by canonical classifier, not evidence that natural language has this exact noise model.
